data.one_liner: Flutter widget to create animated credit cards with brand detection and flip effects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable credit card widget with front and back sides, smooth 3D flip animation, and automatic brand detection and number masking based on the card number.
use_when: You are building a checkout or payment screen in Flutter
You need a realistic credit card representation with automatic card brand recognition
avoid_when: You need to process actual payment transactions or tokenization directly (this is UI only)
strengths: Smooth 3D flip animation between front and back
Automatic card brand detection and number masking for multiple major networks
Extensive customization options for backgrounds, text styles, and layouts
weaknesses: Limited strictly to credit card UI rendering
Does not handle payment processing or validation logic out of the box beyond visual formatting
